meta.prompt: Show the twelve invoices you found as a table with number, customer, date, amount and status: #1001 Acme Corp May 02 $1,200 Paid; #1002 Globex May 05 $860 Due; #1003 Initech May 09 $430 Overdue; #1004 Umbrella May 12 $2,250 Paid; #1005 Hooli May 15 $975 Due; #1006 Stark Ltd May 16 $3,100 Overdue; #1007 Wayne Co May 18 $640 Paid; #1008 Wonka May 20 $1,480 Due; #1009 Soylent May 22 $300 Overdue; #1010 Cyberdyne May 24 $5,200 Paid; #1011 Tyrell May 27 $760 Due; #1012 Aperture May 29 $1,890 Paid. I can sort by any column (date first), filter by status (All, Paid, Due, Overdue), type to search the customer, page through five at a time, and tick rows (and tick all on the page). When anything is ticked a bar shows "N selected" with the total of the ticked amounts and a button to send reminders.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Invoices" "12 invoices, May" icon:"receipt_long" status:"Live"
  Input "Search customer" "Type a customer" =q
  Segments =status options:["All","Paid","Due","Overdue"]
  WideScroll width:390
    TableHeader =sort desc:desc columns:["#","Customer","Date","Amount","Status"] keys:["no","customer","date","amount","status"] selectable:true checked:=length(picked)>0 -> picked=[]
    each r in rows
      TableRow cells:=[r.no,r.customer,r.date,r.amount] badge:=r.status selectable:true checked:=contains(picked,r.no) -> picked=contains(picked,r.no)?without(picked,r.no):append(picked,r.no)
  Pager =page count:=ceil(length(rows)/5)
  if length(picked)>0
    TotalBar "{length(picked)} selected" "Total {money(sum(filter(invoices,x=>contains(picked,x.no)),x=>x.value),"$",0)}" amount:=money(sum(filter(invoices,x=>contains(picked,x.no)),x=>x.value),"$",0) cta:"Send reminders" icon:"mail" -> emit remind picked

state invoices=[{"no":"#1001","customer":"Acme Corp","date":"May 02","amount":"$1,200","value":1200,"status":"Paid"},{"no":"#1002","customer":"Globex","date":"May 05","amount":"$860","value":860,"status":"Due"},{"no":"#1003","customer":"Initech","date":"May 09","amount":"$430","value":430,"status":"Overdue"},{"no":"#1004","customer":"Umbrella","date":"May 12","amount":"$2,250","value":2250,"status":"Paid"},{"no":"#1005","customer":"Hooli","date":"May 15","amount":"$975","value":975,"status":"Due"},{"no":"#1006","customer":"Stark Ltd","date":"May 16","amount":"$3,100","value":3100,"status":"Overdue"},{"no":"#1007","customer":"Wayne Co","date":"May 18","amount":"$640","value":640,"status":"Paid"},{"no":"#1008","customer":"Wonka","date":"May 20","amount":"$1,480","value":1480,"status":"Due"},{"no":"#1009","customer":"Soylent","date":"May 22","amount":"$300","value":300,"status":"Overdue"},{"no":"#1010","customer":"Cyberdyne","date":"May 24","amount":"$5,200","value":5200,"status":"Paid"},{"no":"#1011","customer":"Tyrell","date":"May 27","amount":"$760","value":760,"status":"Due"},{"no":"#1012","customer":"Aperture","date":"May 29","amount":"$1,890","value":1890,"status":"Paid"}]
state picked=[]
state status="All"
state q=""
state sort="date"
state desc=false
state page=0
state rows=sortBy(filter(invoices,x=>(status=="All"||x.status==status)&&(q==""||contains(lower(x.customer),lower(q)))),x=>x[sort])
